'''Cercle Sportif Fola Esch''' ({{Langx|en|Sporting Club Fola Esch}}), usually abbreviated to '''Fola Esch''' or simply '''Fola''', is an [[association football]] club based in [[Esch-sur-Alzette]], in south-western [[Luxembourg]]. They play their home games at [[Stade Émile Mayrisch]], in the south of the city, which they share with their sister [[athletics club]] [[CA Fola Esch]]. They currently compete in the {{Luxembourg football updater|FOL4}}."}}
